scope: Second experiment fixed six datasets x three seeds, historical cost summary, NOT a new standardized end-to-end timing benchmark
aggregation: Average six tables equally within each seed, then mean/sample SD ddof1 over three seeds; SD is seed-mean variability, not table variability
model: Same Qwen3.5-9B BF16, temperature0, original per-seed A100 services; CPU scheduling/load not standardized

definitions.evidforge_first_calls: 10 prior/context learning +1 original model dispatch, counted honestly
definitions.core_seconds: Historical recorded phase sum. Timing ranges differ by method; EF excludes separately recorded outer validation/packaging. Do not label end-to-end or derive overall speedup.
definitions.qualification: Includes predetermined research-prior executions when outer validation failed; does not certify deployment
